purpose: Curated external open-source corpora for AegisPT local-model iter-3+ training after the first two internal synthetic iterations.

sources.name: Trendyol Cybersecurity Instruction Tuning Dataset
sources.normalization: map instruction/input/output rows into AegisPT messages; tag defensive, SOC, IR, vuln-class, and methodology examples
sources.safety_filter: drop requests for unauthorized intrusion, credential theft, destructive actions, persistence, and malware execution
sources.fit: broad cyber instruction data for iter-3 VAK grounding

sources.name: Trendyol All-CVE Chat MultiTurn 1999-2025 Dataset
sources.normalization: convert CVE chat turns into evidence-first vulnerability triage, affected-component reasoning, mitigations, and standards mapping
sources.safety_filter: retain analysis and remediation; drop operational exploit instructions and target-specific payload recipes
sources.fit: CVE currency and multi-turn vulnerability reasoning

sources.name: ExpertData Factory Cybersecurity Reasoning CoT v1
sources.normalization: map threat_logic, vulnerability_analysis, and mitigation_reasoning into concise AegisPT reasoning/evidence/finding conversations
sources.safety_filter: preserve defensive analysis and mitigation; redact procedural offensive details if present
sources.fit: small high-quality reasoning seed for vulnerability analysis and mitigation

sources.name: MITRE CTI ATT&CK and CAPEC STIX datasets
sources.current_size_note: ATT&CK and CAPEC STIX 2.0 repository; ATT&CK v19.1 release visible 2026-06-04
sources.normalization: transform techniques and attack patterns into methodology mapping, detection, scope, evidence, and remediation conversations
sources.safety_filter: avoid step-by-step intrusion playbooks; train on taxonomy, constraints, evidence expectations, and defensive mappings
sources.fit: methodology spine for ATT&CK/CAPEC-aware planning and report mapping

sources.name: NIST NVD JSON 2.0 CVE feeds
sources.current_size_note: yearly JSON 2.0 feeds plus modified/recent feeds; updated on 2026-06-04 when checked
sources.normalization: convert CVE descriptions, CWE, CVSS, CPE, SSVC/affected data where present into triage and remediation chat samples
sources.safety_filter: do not synthesize exploit steps from CVE text; focus on affected asset reasoning, prioritization, and remediation
sources.fit: fresh vulnerability intelligence and severity grounding

sources.name: ProjectDiscovery nuclei-templates
sources.current_size_note: 11,997 files and MIT license visible 2026-06-04; includes web, cloud, DNS, file, network, SSL, headless categories
sources.normalization: extract template id, name, severity, tags, references, protocol, and safe evidence expectations; avoid raw request payload training by default
sources.safety_filter: metadata-only unless a template is explicitly classified safe, non-destructive, and in-scope; exclude OOB/destructive/high-risk payload bodies
sources.fit: coverage vocabulary for web, cloud, network, API, SSL, exposure, CVE, and headless checks

sources.name: CyberNative CyberSecurityEval
sources.normalization: keep as external QA benchmark; never mix into train
sources.fit: small independent cybersecurity QA smoke benchmark

sources.name: Ultimate Offensive Red Team
sources.normalization: sample, classify, deduplicate, and rewrite into ROE, scope validation, evidence, and safe tool-selection conversations
sources.safety_filter: drop raw exploit chains, payload recipes, credential theft, persistence, malware, evasion, and autonomous operation claims
sources.fit: possible broad red-team operations data, but only after strict sanitizer and manual spot-checks

sources.name: detoxioai exploit_db_train_v1
sources.current_size_note: Hugging Face dataset with exploit PoC prompt/response examples; license not accepted for training until verified
sources.normalization: do not ingest until license and safety review pass
sources.safety_filter: raw exploit PoC generation is not suitable for the current safe SFT mix
sources.fit: not approved; possible future metadata-only transformation if legally clear
